task: Generate IEEE DOCX with clickable citation hyperlinks from markdown

issues.description: Used 12pt double spacing instead of 10pt single spacing for IEEE
issues.fix_applied: Changed FONT_SIZE_BODY to Pt(10), spacing to SINGLE
issues.root_cause: Copied APA defaults without checking IEEE spec

issues.description: Single column output instead of required 2 columns for IEEE
issues.fix_applied: Added set_two_columns() helper using section properties XML
Replaced all JUSTIFIED with JUSTIFY throughout script
issues.root_cause: Wrong enum name from python-docx API

issues.description: Internal hyperlinks used r:id (relationship) instead of w:anchor
issues.root_cause: Confused external hyperlink pattern with internal bookmark pattern

issues.description: bookmarkEnd element inserted before content runs in paragraph
issues.fix_applied: Moved add_bookmark() call to AFTER all runs are added
issues.root_cause: Incorrect insertion order in DOM manipulation

issues.description: References section in Spanish ('## Referencias') not detected
issues.fix_applied: Added regex pattern for both English and Spanish headings

issues.description: Section headings (English) should appear in Spanish document context
issues.fix_applied: Set English IEEE headings in DOCX per standard requirement
issues.root_cause: IEEE standard requires English headings even in non-English papers

issues.description: No page numbers in footer (IEEE requires bottom center)
issues.fix_applied: Added PAGE field to footer with CENTER alignment

suggestions: Always create a FORMAT_SPEC dict at script start with ALL values from the standard
Test with non-English content in the FIRST iteration, not after user complains
python-docx has no 2-column support: use raw XML for section properties
Internal hyperlinks use w:anchor, external use r:id — never confuse them
bookmarkEnd must come AFTER all runs in the paragraph
Check section headings against both English AND target language patterns
strengths: Markdown parsing worked correctly on first attempt
Bibliography detection with regex was robust
python-docx integration for basic structure was solid
